description: Bounded inventory and exact executable mappings for delivered portal surfaces that may consume long localized content or bounded large collections. Candidate classification is not executable evidence and does not close Issue #362 or parent #326.

identity.registration-login-session.rationale: Bounded authentication forms and status messages; no user-managed long body or collection route is declared.

identity.password-lifecycle.rationale: Bounded password forms and recovery status messages; no long body or collection route is declared.

identity.mfa-lifecycle.rationale: Bounded MFA forms, QR provisioning and recovery-code state; no long body or paginated collection route is declared.

account.overview-provisioning.rationale: Bounded account binding and provisioning status surface.

account.character-creation-and-visibilit.rationale: Bounded character creation form and visibility outcome; public collection consumers are owned by public.game-data.

public.home-and-seo.rationale: Homepage composes managed announcements and published content; long localized composition and document overflow require explicit evidence before closure.

public.news-and-managed-pages.rationale: The canonical manifest explicitly declares a long-content state for public news and managed pages.

public.game-data.rationale: The canonical manifest explicitly declares pagination across highscores, character search, guild, online and server routes.

admin.core-rbac-cms-audit.rationale: CMS editors consume long managed bodies, while news, pages, roles and audit index routes can render bounded collections.

public.localization-core.rationale: Translation editors consume localized managed-page and news bodies; EN/PL long-value containment requires explicit evidence.

downloads.public-admin-localization.rationale: Public/admin release collections and localized release text are rendered through delivered routes.

events.public-admin.rationale: Calendar/index routes render event collections and event detail/editor routes can consume localized descriptive content.

announcements.admin-localization-home-co.rationale: Administrator announcement collections and long localized announcement text are consumed directly and through homepage composition.

support-legal.public-admin-localization.rationale: Support, rules, terms, privacy and cookie pages are managed localized document surfaces.

wiki.public.rationale: Article bodies consume long content; index, category and search-result routes consume bounded collections.

wiki.admin-editorial-lifecycle.rationale: Article/category administration consumes long editorial bodies and collection indexes.

editorial-media.admin.rationale: The delivered media index renders a bounded collection; binary resource content is outside this ledger.

browser-supporting-media-preview-endpoin.rationale: Resource endpoints do not independently render document layout; evidence belongs to their rendered consumers.

fixture.marker: @portal-community-stress long values multi-page results internal 500 containment and recovery

remaining_gaps: No exact assertion proves readable multi-line wrapping rather than visibility alone.
No exact component-level bounding-box or scroll-containment assertion exists.

public.news-and-managed-pages.reason: Existing CMS evidence creates and renders only short English values, while localization evidence verifies shell navigation rather than long managed EN/PL bodies.
missing: document-level horizontal overflow assertion on the long-content routes

nonclaims: Candidate classification is not proof that the state has been exercised.
The public.game-data mapping does not yet prove readable wrapping or component-level containment.
No unbounded dataset, performance, staging, production or Canary behavior is proven.
Issue #362 and parent #326 remain open until executable mappings and fail-closed validation are complete.
